description:
You are a GIS analyst supporting an international economic policy research team. The team needs a country-level dataset enriched with GDP per capita values for comparative analysis across nations.

Using gvSIG Desktop and the countries shapefile at /home/ga/gvsig_data/countries/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp, add a new numeric field named GDP_PCAP to the layer. Populate this field with GDP per capita in US dollars for each country, computed as: (GDP_MD_EST × 1,000,000) ÷ POP_EST — where GDP_MD_EST is GDP in millions of USD and POP_EST is total population in persons.

Once the new field is computed, export the updated dataset (with all original fields plus the new GDP_PCAP field) as a new shapefile to /home/ga/gvsig_exports/countries_gdp_percapita.shp.
